name: combo-box
title: Combo Box
description: A searchable multi-select combo box with tag display for selected items.

docs.lead: A searchable multi-select combo box. Select from a list of options with search filtering, tag display, and configurable min/max constraints.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Basic multi-select combo box with search.
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root
  options={options}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  placeholder="Select sectors..."
  searchPlaceholder="Search sectors..."
/>

examples.title: With Icon
examples.description: Combo box with a leading icon on the trigger.
examples.code:
<ComboBox.Root
  options={options}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  placeholder="Select languages..."
  icon={RiGlobalLine}
/>

examples.title: Max Selection
examples.description: Limit the number of selections allowed.

examples.title: Min Selection
examples.description: Prevent removing items below a minimum count.

examples.title: Select All
examples.description: When all options are selected, show a single summary tag.

api.name: ComboBox.Root
api.description: The main combo box component. Combines a styled trigger button, searchable command popover, and tag display for selected items.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger placeholder when nothing is selected

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Search input placeholder inside the dropdown

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when no options match the search

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon component on the trigger

props.name: allowAdding
props.description: Show add message when no results found

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: When provided and all options selected, show a single summary tag

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when popover open state changes
